name: Performance prospecting, cold tennis-interest audiences (learning test)
execution: Meta/YouTube video, FTS ₹199 in marquee weeks, geo-split
rule: Stop at day 30 unless attributed CAC < ₹300; shift remainder to C2

name: High-intent search + retargeting at T-48h, new-to-pay tennis intent
persona: P2 (free tennis viewers, tennis-page visitors, lapsed 2025 buyers)
execution: Google search on tennis/live terms; Meta retargeting of tennis page visitors and free-content viewers; control IDs excluded via customer lists
rule: Scale if attributed ≤ ₹200 and incremental ≤ ₹300; pause at ₹250 attributed

name: First-party CRM activation (push, email, in-app) with 10% persistent holdout
persona: P2-free (new payers); P3/P4/P5 (existing payers, first ATP purchase)
execution: Segment-specific pushes at T-48h and 07:00 IST morning replay; suppression after purchase; 3 pushes/week cap
evidence: planning pools are assumptions to be replaced with CRM counts on day 0; rates are assumptions; holdout readout
rule: Keep if measured relative lift ≥ 30%; otherwise fold into C2

name: Tennis communities and contests (e.g., Indian Tennis Daily), pass prizes
execution: 3 contests (Shanghai, Paris, Finals) with pass prizes; creator fees; light boosting
evidence: case CVR 7.8% (CF12); effective CPC is an assumption
rule: Continue only if effective CPC ≤ ₹8.6 (CPC ceiling at 55% new-payer share)

name: Editorial and native tennis personalities (Race to Turin, 20-minute Morning Match cuts, weekly-show tie-ins)
execution: Existing weekly show + 2 editors on event weeks; personality segments; zero incremental rights cost but production costed
rule: Cut if morning-replay open rate < 15% and no next-event return lift

name: ESPN.in takeovers converted to a geo/time-split test (2 marquee weeks)
execution: Takeover live in test cities, held out in matched cities, crossover between Shanghai and Paris weeks
rule: Scale only if geo lift in new payers is positive at p<0.1

name: Retention: morning-replay journey creative, upgrade and renewal communications
execution: Onboarding, post-first-view, pre-next-event, expiry and season-end bridge messages

name: Measurement and analytics (holdout operations, geo design, dashboards, analyst time)
